rivalries.name: Connor Bowl
rivalries.description: Connor Kaminska and Connor Reardon play for sole possession of the first name.
rivalries.stakes: The latest winner remains Connor. The loser is Redacted until the next decisive meeting.

rivalries.name: Brother Bowl
rivalries.description: The Ansel brothers settle the family name on the QPFL scoreboard.
rivalries.stakes: The latest winner keeps Ansel. The loser is Redacted until the next decisive meeting.

rivalries.name: Kuhl Cup
rivalries.description: Bill Kuhl and Joe Kuhl meet with the family name on the line.
rivalries.stakes: The latest winner keeps Kuhl. The loser is Censored until the next decisive meeting.
